article: A man has been arrested on suspicion of murder after the body of a woman was discovered in a burning house in South Yorkshire. Firefighters were called to the property in Barnsley on Friday evening and discovered the body inside. Police said a 38-year-old man had been detained and remains in custody.

t5: A murder investigation is under way after a woman was found dead in a burning house in South Yorkshire.

article: England manager Gareth Southgate has named an unchanged squad for next month's World Cup qualifiers against Slovenia and Lithuania. Striker Harry Kane leads the attack after scoring 11 goals in his last seven appearances for club and country. England need just two points to secure automatic qualification.

article: Archaeologists in Egypt have uncovered an ancient tomb containing eight mummies, 10 wooden coffins and more than a thousand funerary statues. The 3,500-year-old tomb near the city of Luxor belonged to a city nobleman named Userhat who was a chancellor, the antiquities ministry said.

article: A new species of giant flying squirrel has been identified in the dense forests of south-western China. Scientists say the rodent, which weighs nearly two kilograms and can glide through the air for distances of up to 400 metres, was discovered during a biodiversity survey of the Gaoligong Mountains.

t5: A new species of giant flying squirrel capable of gliding 400m has been discovered in south-western China.
